ai_rationale: Commissioned officers handle strategic and tactical decision-making requiring human judgment, physical presence, and classified operations. AI may assist in intelligence analysis and logistics planning, but core leadership and combat roles remain firmly human-directed in the Indian military context.
description: Plan, direct and coordinate military operations in the army, navy, air force or other armed services branches. They hold ranks from lieutenant / sub-lieutenant upward.

ai_rationale: NCOs primarily supervise personnel, maintain equipment, and execute tactical operations requiring physical presence and interpersonal authority. Limited digital workflow involvement reduces AI exposure in the Indian armed forces.
description: Supervise and lead small units of enlisted military personnel. Responsibilities include enforcing discipline, training troops and ensuring operational readiness.

ai_rationale: Other ranks perform physical, field-based military duties — combat operations, equipment handling, guard duties — with minimal digital component. The Indian military operates largely through traditional command structures at this level.
description: Perform military duties at the enlisted level including guard duties, weapons handling, vehicle operation and participation in military exercises and combat operations.

occupation_title: Chief Executives, Senior Officials and Legislators
ai_rationale: Strategic decision-making partially augmented by AI analytics, but human judgment remains central.
description: Determine and formulate policies, direct and plan the activities of enterprises, governments and other organisations, or manage them on their own behalf or on behalf of shareholders.

ai_rationale: Administrative workflows increasingly automated; commercial decision-support via AI tools growing.
description: Plan, organise, direct, control and coordinate the financial, administrative, human resource, policy, planning, research, marketing and advertising activities of enterprises.

ai_rationale: Production scheduling and logistics benefiting from AI optimisation; core management role persists.
description: Plan, direct and coordinate production activities in agriculture, forestry, manufacturing, mining, construction, transport, health, education, ICT and other specialised services.

occupation_title: Hospitality, Retail and Other Services Managers
ai_rationale: Customer-facing management roles less automatable; AI aids inventory and demand forecasting.
description: Plan, organise, direct, control and coordinate the activities of commercial enterprises providing hospitality, retail, sport, recreation and other consumer services.

ai_rationale: Research, analysis and design tasks increasingly aided by AI; coding co-pilots and simulation tools widely used.
description: Conduct research, improve or develop concepts and theories, and apply scientific and engineering knowledge in fields such as physics, chemistry, mathematics, statistics and engineering.

ai_rationale: AI diagnostic aids growing but clinical judgment, empathy and procedural skill remain essential.
description: Conduct research, diagnose and treat human illnesses and disorders, and provide related services. Includes medical doctors, dentists, pharmacists, nursing and midwifery professionals, and traditional medicine practitioners.

ai_rationale: AI tutoring and content generation tools augment teachers; interpersonal and mentoring roles less affected.
description: Teach the theory and practice of one or more disciplines at various educational levels from primary and secondary schools to universities. Includes special education teachers and other education professionals.

ai_rationale: Financial analysis, marketing analytics, and HR processes heavily augmented by AI tools.
description: Analyse and advise on financial, accounting, policy, organisational and management matters. Includes accountants, financial and investment advisers, human resource and management consultants.

ai_rationale: Software development, data analysis and system administration significantly impacted by AI coding assistants and automation.
description: Design, develop, test and maintain software, hardware and network systems. Includes software developers, database administrators, systems analysts and web developers.

ai_rationale: Legal research, content creation and translation tasks highly exposed; cultural and social work less so.
description: Provide legal services, conduct social-science research, minister to religious groups and create literary, visual and performing art works. Includes lawyers, economists, social workers, journalists and artists.

ai_rationale: Hands-on technical work less automatable; AI assists in diagnostics and quality control.
description: Perform technical tasks in research, engineering, manufacturing, construction, mining and related fields under the supervision of science and engineering professionals.

ai_rationale: Patient care, sample collection and community health work require physical presence and empathy.
description: Provide technical and practical support in health services. Includes medical and pharmaceutical technicians, nursing associates, physiotherapy technicians and community health workers.

ai_rationale: Insurance agents, sales reps and accounting associates face significant AI automation of routine tasks.
description: Perform business, finance, administration, sales, insurance and related functions at a technical or paraprofessional level. Includes bookkeepers, insurance agents, customs officers and real estate agents.

occupation_title: Legal, Social, Cultural and Related Associate Professionals
ai_rationale: Paralegal, social and religious associate roles see moderate AI augmentation in documentation.
description: Provide support services in legal, social, cultural, sport and religious fields. Includes paralegals, social work associates, sports coaches and religious associates.

ai_rationale: Network support, system administration and web technician roles increasingly automated.
description: Provide technical support for ICT systems including installation, testing, maintenance and repair of hardware, networks and user applications.

ai_rationale: Data entry, typing, filing and general office tasks highly susceptible to automation and AI tools.
description: Record, organise, store, compute and retrieve data and information. Includes typists, data-entry operators and general office clerks.

ai_rationale: Chatbots and AI customer service tools rapidly replacing routine enquiry and complaint handling.
description: Interact directly with clients and customers to provide information, handle complaints and process transactions. Includes bank tellers, receptionists and call-centre agents.

ai_rationale: Accounting, bookkeeping, payroll and stock-keeping tasks heavily automated by software and AI.
description: Record, compute and retrieve financial and statistical data, and keep records of materials, goods and transport schedules. Includes accounting clerks and stock clerks.

ai_rationale: Mail sorting, coding, proofreading and other clerical tasks largely automatable.
description: Perform clerical duties not classified elsewhere such as coding, proof-reading, filing and sorting mail. Includes library clerks and mail carriers.

ai_rationale: Cooks, waiters, hairdressers and personal care workers perform physical tasks requiring human touch.
description: Provide personal services related to travel, housekeeping, food preparation, hairdressing, beauty treatment, companionship and other areas. Includes cooks, waiters and hairdressers.

ai_rationale: Retail and street sales require physical presence; e-commerce recommendation engines alter landscape.
description: Sell goods and services wholesale or retail, operate market stalls and demonstrate goods. Includes shop keepers, street vendors and sales demonstrators.

ai_rationale: Childcare, elderly care and home-based health support require empathy and physical presence.
description: Provide personal care to children, the elderly and persons with health problems at home or in care institutions. Includes child care workers and home-based health aides.

ai_rationale: Security guards and police require physical presence; surveillance AI assists but does not replace.
description: Protect persons and property against fire, illegal acts and other hazards. Includes police officers, fire-fighters and private security guards.

occupation_group: Skilled Agricultural, Forestry and Fishery Workers
ai_rationale: Smallholder farming is physical and context-dependent; precision agriculture AI adoption is nascent in India.
description: Plan, organise and perform farming operations to grow and harvest crops, breed and raise livestock and produce a variety of animal husbandry products for sale or delivery to wholesale buyers and marketing organisations.

occupation_title: Market-oriented Skilled Forestry, Fishery and Hunting Workers
occupation_group: Skilled Agricultural, Forestry and Fishery Workers
ai_rationale: Forest product gathering and fishing are manual, location-specific tasks with minimal AI applicability.
description: Plan, organise and perform forestry, aquaculture and hunting operations to grow and harvest timber, cultivate and catch fish, and hunt or trap wild animals for market sale.

occupation_title: Subsistence Farmers, Fishers, Hunters and Gatherers
occupation_group: Skilled Agricultural, Forestry and Fishery Workers
ai_rationale: Subsistence activities are manual and survival-oriented; technology penetration is very low.
description: Grow crops, raise livestock, catch fish, hunt or gather wild products primarily for their own consumption or that of their household. Common in rural India where small and marginal holdings predominate.

occupation_title: Building and Related Trades Workers (excluding Electricians)
ai_rationale: Masonry, carpentry and plumbing are physical manual tasks; AI has minimal direct impact.
description: Construct, maintain and repair buildings, roads and other structures. Includes masons, carpenters, plasterers, roofers and floor layers.

occupation_title: Metal, Machinery and Related Trades Workers
ai_rationale: Welding, machining and fitting require dexterity; CNC and robotic welding growing but skilled workers still needed.
description: Cast, weld, forge, shape and tool metal; install, fit and maintain machinery, equipment and mechanical components. Includes blacksmiths, welders and fitters.

ai_rationale: Artisan handicrafts are manual; printing pre-press and typesetting partially automated by digital tools.
description: Produce handmade decorative articles, pottery, glass, textile and leather craft goods. Set up and operate printing presses and bind books.

ai_rationale: Electrical installation and repair are hands-on; diagnostic AI tools emerging but not dominant.
description: Install, maintain and repair electrical wiring, motors, transformers, electronic equipment and telecommunications systems. Includes electricians and electronics mechanics.

occupation_title: Food Processing, Wood Working, Garment and Other Craft Workers
ai_rationale: Baking, butchering and food preservation involve manual skill; industrial automation limited in India.
description: Process food, work with wood, make garments and perform other craft-related activities. Includes butchers, bakers, tailors, cabinet makers and weavers.

occupation_group: Plant and Machine Operators, and Assemblers
ai_rationale: Machine operation involves monitoring and control; AI-driven process automation gradually increasing.
description: Operate and monitor stationary industrial machinery and equipment used in mining, manufacturing, processing and utilities. Includes machine tool operators and chemical plant operators.

occupation_group: Plant and Machine Operators, and Assemblers
ai_rationale: Assembly line work partially automatable with robotics; India's labour cost keeps manual assembly viable.
description: Assemble component parts of manufactured products such as mechanical, electrical, electronic and metal articles according to specifications.

occupation_group: Plant and Machine Operators, and Assemblers
ai_rationale: Autonomous vehicles are emerging but Indian road conditions and regulations delay full automation.
description: Drive and operate trains, motor vehicles, mobile heavy equipment and other transport machinery. Includes truck drivers, bus drivers and auto-rickshaw drivers.

ai_rationale: Cleaning, sweeping and domestic help are manual tasks with very low AI exposure.
description: Sweep, wash, dust and clean buildings, vehicles and public areas; wash dishes, laundry and assist in kitchens and households.

ai_rationale: Manual farm labour, weeding, harvesting and plucking are physical tasks with negligible AI impact.
description: Perform simple routine tasks in crop production, forestry, fishing and hunting, usually under supervision. Includes farm labourers and plantation workers.

occupation_title: Labourers in Mining, Construction, Manufacturing and Transport
ai_rationale: Heavy manual labour in construction and mining with minimal scope for AI replacement.
description: Perform simple routine physical tasks in mining, construction, manufacturing and transport sectors. Includes hand packers, load carriers and earth-moving labourers.

ai_rationale: Fast food preparation and kitchen help are manual and low-skill with negligible AI applicability.
description: Prepare and cook food in restaurants, hotels, street stalls and homes following simple recipes or instructions. Includes kitchen helpers and fast-food preparers.

occupation_title: Street and Related Sales and Service Workers
ai_rationale: Street vendors, shoe shiners and car washers perform in-person services with no AI exposure.
description: Sell goods and provide services on streets and in public places. Includes newspaper vendors, shoe shiners and door-to-door salespersons.

occupation_title: Refuse Workers and Other Elementary Workers
ai_rationale: Waste collection, sweeping and odd-job tasks are manual with negligible AI impact.
description: Collect and sort refuse, sweep streets and public places, and perform other elementary tasks not classified elsewhere. Includes garbage collectors and manual scavengers.
